title: Technology Sector Update for 12/03/2018: IQ, QCOM, NOK, MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG - Nasdaq.com
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Technology Stocks:
MSFT: +1.90%
AAPL: +3.07%
IBM: +1.39%
CSCO: +1.25%
GOOG: +2.70%
Technology stocks were trending higher in pre-market trading Monday.
Stocks moving on news include:
(+) Iqiyi ( IQ ), which was 7% higher after it unveiled the world's first virtual AI/AR sign language interpreter for its video content.
(+) Qualcomm ( QCOM ) was up by more than 3% after a Reuters report that the company said that it sees no prospect for reviving its failed $44 billion acquisition of Dutch peer NXP Semiconductors ( NXPI ) despite a suggestion from the White House that the Chinese government could still welcome the deal "should it again be presented."
(+) Nokia ( NOK ) was more than 2% higher after it announced a EUR250 million loan transaction with the Nordic Investment Bank to finance research and development activities into 5G technology in Europe from 2018 to 2020.
